author: Davidgo5867

english.text: One day, Kateb Yacine, our great writer, and famous playwright, was called to receive a prize. As he walked onto the stage, he stumbled and "some people" laughed. He turned around and said to them, "La Fontaine made the animals laugh and today I made you laugh!" This story could have happened and is very believable and timeless, even if it was necessarily spread by word of mouth. Kateb Yacine was a great humble artist and was said to drink immoderately and, as an opponent on principle, he was best known for his escapades.

jyutping: jau5 jat1 jat6，ngo5 dei6 ge3 wai5 daai6 zok3 gaa1、zyu3 ming4 kek6 zok3 gaa1 Kateb Yacine bei6 giu3 heoi3 lo2 zoeng2，dong1 keoi5 haang4 soeng5 toi4 go2 zan6，keoi5 dit3 dit3 zong6 zong6，jin4 hau6「jau5 di1 jan4」siu3 zo2，keoi5 zyun3 san1 tung4 keoi5 dei6 gong2：「 La Fontaine ling6 dou3 di1 dung6 mat6 siu3，ji4 gam1 jat6 ngo5 ling6 dou3 nei5 dei6 siu3 zo2！」ni1 go3 gu3 si6 bun2 loi4 ho2 ji5 faat3 sang1，ji4 ce2 hai6 fei1 soeng4 ho2 seon3 tung4 wing5 hang4，zau6 syun3 keoi5 jat1 ding6 hai6 hau2 ji5 soeng1 cyun4。 Kateb Yacine hai6 jat1 go3 hou2 him1 heoi1 ge3 ngai6 seot6 gaa1，geoi3 gong2 keoi5 jam2 zau2 m4 sik1 loeng6，zok3 wai4 jyun4 zak1 soeng6 ge3 deoi3 sau2，keoi5 zeoi3 ceot1 meng2 hai6 keoi5 ge3 tou4 bei6 hang4 wai4。
text: 有一日，我哋嘅偉大作家、著名劇作家 Kateb Yacine 被叫去攞獎，當佢行上台嗰陣，佢跌跌撞撞，然後「有啲人」笑咗，佢轉身同佢哋講：「 La Fontaine 令到啲動物笑，而今日我令到你哋笑咗！」呢個故事本來可以發生，而且係非常可信同永恆，就算佢一定係口耳相傳。 Kateb Yacine 係一個好謙虛嘅藝術家，據講佢飲酒唔適量，作為原則上嘅對手，佢最出名係佢嘅逃避行為。
